evals.name: interface-en-chat
evals.prompt: I made a little demo track (test_song.wav) and wrote lyrics with timestamps (lyrics_en.lrc). Make me a lyric video where the song plays out as a chat on a screen: the singer is texting someone who never quite answers in time. Whole song, 1920x1080.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole 34 s song in the interface style: a code-drawn chat client where the lyric lines arrive as the singer's messages with the voice, the other side shown only through typing / presence / short replies, colour states that change on events, keyword plates in the chorus, an ending event; all lines readable; no lyric text in code.

evals.name: signal-zh-glitch
evals.prompt: 帮我给 test_song.wav 做一个故障风、信号劣化的PV，歌词是 lyrics_zh.lrc（带时间轴）。要很强的疾走感快剪，画面像一台快坏掉的录像设备，越到副歌越“热”。可以用 Grok 生图。1920x1080，整首。
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole song in the vocaloid style, mostly its signal kit: tiered fast cuts with filler frames that speed up in the chorus, a heat grade that rises toward the chorus, analog tearing / sensor noise, a recorder HUD, correctly rendered Chinese lyrics (no tofu), 回家 lines as peaks; passes the flash check.

evals.name: tegaki-vertical-plain
evals.prompt: need a vertical lyric MV (1080x1920, 30fps) for reels from test_song.wav. i only have the lyrics as plain text (lyrics_en_plain.txt), no timestamps. singing starts at about 4 seconds and each line is roughly 2 bars. illustrated anime look with an original character, a river at dusk with paper lanterns on the water. use grok for the art.
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1920 30 fps MP4 with estimated lyric timing starting ~4.25 s and a note that timing is estimated; illustrated original character and dusk river; lanterns sit ON the water (not floating above it); soft light sources; a composed final frame.

evals.name: treatise-en-plates
evals.prompt: Here's my demo song (test_song.wav) with timed lyrics (lyrics_en.lrc). Make a deadpan lyric video that looks like the plates of an old technical treatise or instruction manual: charts, diagrams, engraved illustrations, the words set into each plate. No image generator. Whole song, 1920x1080.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole 34 s song in the interface style, mostly its treatise plates: ink and bone plates with one signal colour, a different plate idiom per line (chart, scope, form, map, engraved 3D form, hairline field), per-word lyrics set into each plate, at least one shader-drawn engraved plate and a line written by the pen, a running number raised by the hooks; cuts on the beat; no lyric text in code.

evals.name: vocaloid-en-singer
evals.prompt: Here's my demo song (test_song.wav) with timed lyrics (lyrics_en.lrc). Make an illustrated anime lyric video with an original girl who sings it, by a river at dusk with paper lanterns on the water. She stays mostly still, and her expression changes once or twice. Use NovelAI for the art. Whole song, 1920x1080.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole 34 s song in the vocaloid style: an original character generated with NovelAI, no partial face replacement (no blink, expression or mouth patches over a picture), each expression change a whole picture swapped in or cut to, a dusk river with lanterns sitting on the water, JIZURA or code lyrics; cuts on the beat; no lyric text in code.

evals.name: own-en-film
evals.prompt: Here's my demo song (test_song.wav) with timed lyrics (lyrics_en.lrc). Make a music video for it, whole song, 1920x1080.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole 34 s song in a style the film designs for itself (no preset was asked for): docs/CONCEPT.md defines it (a Reads-as line, 6-10 traits, palette system, type roles, shape grammar, motion feel), the film's own scene file draws it, library techniques and shared elements only where they serve the song, no preset's overall look; cuts on the beat; every line shown; no lyric text in code.

evals.name: magazine-en-press
evals.prompt: Here's my demo song (test_song.wav) with timed lyrics (lyrics_en.lrc). Make a lyric video that looks like a Japanese experimental print magazine: risograph spreads, vertical type, the page itself reacting to the music until something happens to it at the end. No image generator. Whole song, 1920x1080.
evals.expected_output: A 1920x1080 MP4 of the whole 34 s song in the magazine style: every frame printed in three inks with visible screens and misregistration, vertical lyric type revealed as sung, editorial marks (folios, rulers, proof circles) that keep time with the music, spreads that change on the beat, a page fate at the end (burned, torn, flashed or closed); every line shown; no lyric text in code.
